name: journey-964
explain: Executable chapter fixture accompanying Testing, profiling and reliable delivery. The full mechanism and independent tasks are linked in the course unit.
steps: Inspect the declared input and required invariant. || Trace the chapter mechanism and reproduce the stated case. || Change the stated assumption and defend the result.
limit: Small executable fixture; it does not establish all behavior of the larger linked course unit.

name: streaming-iterator-memory-guard
explain: Contrast lazy generator pipelines with eager list materialization to prevent OOM memory explosions and support early short-circuit termination.
steps: Simulate an unbounded stream of log records. || Compose lazy filter and map generators in O(1) memory. || Assert that eager collection retains full memory while streaming short-circuits on demand.
expect: All streaming iterator memory assertions verified successfully.

name: runtime-type-validation-guard
explain: Demonstrate that Python type annotations are purely advisory metadata for static analyzers, requiring explicit runtime validation guards at system boundaries.
steps: Show standard Python function silently accepting string arguments in place of integers, causing data corruption. || Implement runtime type boundary enforcement decorator. || Assert that invalid parameter types raise explicit validation errors at the call site.
expect: All runtime type validation assertions verified successfully.

name: reproducible-regression-test-harness
explain: Author an independent regression test with exact Decimal arithmetic to catch binary floating-point representation drift and premature line rounding.
steps: Construct a minimal reproducing invoice fixture with fractional pricing. || Show that binary float arithmetic yields precision drift and rounding errors. || Assert that exact Decimal quantization satisfies the independent monetary contract.
expect: All regression test assertions verified successfully.

name: deterministic-environment-lock-manifest
explain: Verify environment reproducibility across machines using pinned dependency hashes, explicit random seeds, and dataset content digests.
steps: Demonstrate that unseeded random operations cause train/validation partition divergence. || Build an immutable experiment manifest recording commit SHA, seed, and package hashes. || Assert that environment parity passes while version or seed drift is flagged immediately.
expect: All environment lock manifest assertions verified successfully.

name: stateful-resource-lifecycle-manager
explain: Encapsulate mutable state and connection lifecycles within classes using the Context Manager protocol (__enter__/__exit__) to guarantee cleanup and protect invariants.
steps: Contrast pure stateless functional transformations with stateful resource management. || Implement database connection session enforcing transaction rollback on error and auto-close. || Assert that operations on closed sessions raise ResourceClosedError.
expect: All stateful resource lifecycle assertions verified successfully.
